# Owned diagnostic repository: schedule

Public API: candidate_app.handle({operation, payload}). Inputs must remain unchanged.

- merge: Merge sorted or unsorted integer [start,end] intervals, including touching intervals; preserve the input.
- overlap: Return the duration shared by two half-open integer intervals, never negative.
- due: Return task IDs whose ISO dates are on or before today, retaining input order.
- slots: Return all whole [start,end] slots of positive length within a day range; include the last exact-fit slot.
- elapsed: Return elapsed whole minutes between timezone-aware ISO timestamps, accounting for offsets.

Run public checks with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
